description: This Go source file defines data structures and functions for constructing and handling AI request messages, including JSON schema generation and request configuration options.

classes.name: Message
classes.description: Represents a chat message with role and content.

classes.name: Request
classes.description: Represents an AI completion request with configurable parameters.

classes.name: ResponseFormat
classes.description: Specifies the desired output format, either JSON object or JSON schema.

classes.name: JSONSchema
classes.description: Defines the structure for structured JSON outputs, including schema details.

methods.name: WithSystem
methods.description: Adds a system message to the request.

methods.name: WithModel
methods.description: Overrides the default model used in the request.

methods.name: WithAPIKey
methods.description: Overrides the client's API key for this request.

methods.name: WithTemperature
methods.description: Sets the temperature parameter for the request.

methods.name: WithMaxTokens
methods.description: Sets the maximum number of tokens to generate.

methods.name: WithSchema
methods.description: Enables structured output with a JSON schema, converting Go structs to JSON schema if needed.
